name: setup-pah
summary: Configures Private Automation Hub remotes on the running AAP instance.

lifecycle.idempotency: Reuses the encrypted Automation Hub token and reconciles owned remotes and synchronization settings.
lifecycle.failure_boundary: Stops before remote configuration when token validation, AAP access, or Pulp synchronization fails.

readiness: Owned remotes are configured and their Pulp synchronization tasks complete.

security.secret_storage: The Automation Hub offline token is stored in the encrypted credential Vault.
security.network_trust: AAP and Automation Hub requests retain TLS verification.
security.external_actions: Only the configured AAP Private Automation Hub remotes are changed.
